missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Война' is the feminine nominative subject of 'длилась', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Эта' points at a specific war and 'четыре года' gives the duration.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Войну' is the accusative direct object of 'ненавидит'. 'Любую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'народ' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb of fear. 'Войны' is genitive because 'бояться' governs the genitive. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'все' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Войне' is the dative form required by the preposition 'к', expressing preparation toward something. 'Они' is the nominative subject of 'готовятся'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Войну' is the accusative object of 'закончили', while 'миром' is the instrumental noun showing the means by which the war ended.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О войне' uses the prepositional form 'войне' after 'о' to express the topic of telling. 'Дед' is the nominative subject and 'много' adds quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with dative recipient. 'Война' is the feminine nominative subject of 'принесла'. 'Людям' is the dative recipient and 'горе' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Войн' is the genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Страшных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'история' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На войне' uses the prepositional form 'войне' after 'на' to mean during the war. 'Тысячи солдат' is the quantified subject of 'погибли'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Война' is the feminine nominative subject of 'изменила', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Всю страну' is the accusative object of the change.
